name: succeed_keeps_a_failure_an_explicit_edge_matches
workflow:
digraph T {
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  a [prompt="x", on_failure="succeed"]
  recover [prompt="x"]
  b [prompt="x"]
  start -> a
  a -> recover [condition="outcome=failed"]
  a -> b
  recover -> exit
  b -> exit

}
